invariants.rationale: The return value of the method is a Map created via context.mapToPair, which should never return null.
The only parameter of the method is used without a prior null check, so it is expected to be non-null at exit.
The keys of the returned map are constructed from the partition paths extracted from writeResult's WriteStatus list.
The result map has one entry per distinct partition path among the WriteStatus list, so size can't exceed the list size.
All values in the result map are constructed via getAllExistingFileIds, so none should be null.
